answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reset on any identity-link attempt, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the pulse of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The nectar holds work receipts rather than names, so the comet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
